items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You're the guy Louie on Lutzenz. Did you ever play Lutzenz? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh Lutzenz? Who's that? The Jew, everybody's that.

ctx.x: Well I haven't seen him in a long time but he's a good musician. Well he's the one to go
by the music. Go by the music. You're the guy Louie on Lutzenz. Did you ever play Lutzenz?

Oh Lutzenz? Who's that? The Jew, everybody's that. Yeah. I played all out there. And in fact, I mean I've been a lot of places on the early start. I used to, one week I'd be on the Gulf Coast, next week I'd be going to Meridian, and Harrisburg, Poplarville, Picayune, all them places like that slide out. You know one week we'd go to this place, next week then we'd go to Mobile, Pensacola, Florida, and back into Biloxi, Gulf Coast, Paris Christian, Bay St. Louis.
